name: Magmadar
source: [logs: Season of Discovery] Melee 1,902 to 2,699 before armor under the bench's raid debuffs, a swing every 1.37 s on the tank: Warcraft Logs, 47 kills on Season of Discovery (Normal, 2026-09-08 to 2026-11-02): the median of 179 normal hits' unmitigatedAmount (2,249), the 5th to 95th percentile of each hit over its own kill's median (172 hits) stretched to an even roll, and the swings a second while he was on the main tank. Taken back through the debuffs the bench puts on him (attack power 805 to 601, -37 a swing, attack speed 0.833): 1,560 weapon damage, spread 0.511, a 1.14 s swing. Length: the kills' length, median 29 s (10th to 90th percentile 16 to 39). Abilities: Lava Breath 19272 1,157 to 1,343 Fire, frontal (the Classic Era client's spell data; a 2006 Molten Core log from Blizzard's servers, in WWS format, had it at 624 average). Its timer is assumed: the cmangos script triggers it with Frenzy.
abilitiesSource: Lava Breath 19272 1,157 to 1,343 Fire, frontal (the Classic Era client's spell data; a 2006 Molten Core log from Blizzard's servers, in WWS format, had it at 624 average). Its timer is assumed: the cmangos script triggers it with Frenzy.
notes: Frenzy (+150% attack speed for 8 s) is in the logs' swing rate, as much of it as the raids let through. Magma Spit (a Fire DoT on attackers), Panic (fear) and Lava Bomb are left out. Lava Breath's timer is assumed (the script triggers it with Frenzy in cmangos).

healing.notes: From Season of Discovery's logs (47 kills): while the boss was on the main tank, 3 healers had 5% or more of its healing (the median kill), and the healing it took from others was 1,121 a second with overheal and absorbs (19% of the heals effective), 1.65 heals and HoT ticks a second, against 327 damage taken a second. The tank's own heals (6% of its healing) are left out. Main tanks: Druid 16, Warlock 11, Paladin 8, Shaman 6, Warrior 5, Rogue 1.
